confidence_notes: Meal and coffee estimates are better anchored than accommodation and drinks; the Hoi An cost index had only 13 contributors in the past 18 months. Wine is a rough estimate based on its local bar-price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Hoi An's tourism demand suggests a modest premium over Sa Pa and Ninh Binh guesthouses and three-star rooms, while remaining below resort-oriented Phu Quoc. Dorm and private-room estimates are slightly above Ninh Binh.
